$comment: THE SINGLE DEFINITION of the audit-anchors housekeeping schema. There is no other.
It used to live in TWO places at once: templates/audit-anchors.md.template (the declared
canonical, never shipped to a consumer by install.sh) and the header of each project's live
_bmad-output/audit-anchors.md (a hand-carried copy the retro producer reads). Nothing compared
them. They diverged: the live header grew an `audit_window` field and switched to a YAML list,
while the template still described `---`-separated documents with a `notes` field and no
audit_window. The de-facto schema survived only in whichever project's file was carried forward;
a fresh install would have seeded the stale template's shape and produced entries the consumers
(carry-over-evaluation Step 1a, gate-validation Check 18) no longer parse.
So: the reader LOADS this file. The header every producer reads is RENDERED from `header_lines`
by scripts/validate-audit-anchors.sh --render into a BEGIN/END GENERATED region.
scripts/validate-audit-anchors.sh --check fails closed if that region drifts, and the same
script validates every entry against `fields`. Add or change a field HERE and it reaches the
rendered header and the entry validator at once. Do not hand-edit the header region.
Same cure as schemas/provenance-block.json: not a drift detector — nothing to detect.
$fields_comment: Enforce ONLY the STRUCTURE a reader depends on — `sprint` is an integer, `sha` is present and
non-empty — not the historical FORMAT of the values. Real consumer files carry short SHAs,
angle-bracket placeholders (`<6db95…>`), and per-sprint PENDING variants (`<PENDING-S199-RETRO>`);
whether a value actually resolves to a mergeable rev is gate-validation Check 18's decision (it
fails closed on a non-resolvable prior-sprint sha), NOT this validator's. A stricter pattern here
re-creates the wedge this whole change exists to remove: a linter that errors on real data on

sha.desc: retro-PR merge SHA on main (short or full), or a PENDING placeholder until merged

audit_window.desc: <prior-sprint-sha>..<sprint-N-sha> git rev range for the next sprint's per-class test-debt audit (documentary)

header_lines: Append-only YAML list of per-sprint retro-PR merge SHAs. Producer: `retro.md`
Step 5b at sprint close. Consumers: `carry-over-evaluation.md` Step 1a and
**Schema is canonical in `.claude/schemas/audit-anchors.json`.** This header is
RENDERED from it by `scripts/validate-audit-anchors.sh --render` and byte-checked by
`--check`; the same script validates every entry. Do NOT hand-edit this region — edit
the schema and re-render. Each entry:
- `sha: <sha>` — retro-PR merge SHA on `main` (short or full), or `PENDING`. REQUIRED.
- `closed_at: <time>` — when the retro PR merged (documentary; free-form).
- `audit_window: <prior-sprint-sha>..<sprint-N-sha>` — git rev range for the next
sprint's per-class test-debt audit; the lower bound is the prior sprint's `sha`.
Missing entry for the prior sprint OR `sha: PENDING` there FAILS Check 18 CLOSED —
a silent skip on a missing audit anchor is forbidden (PI-S169-8).
